path.alternate: CELESTEA_LLM_FALLBACKS = the same JSON inline (wins over the file)
path.switch: CELESTEA_LLM_FALLBACK=on|1|true|yes; anything else (and absent) = OFF, and the file is not even read
path.mode: read-only (never written by the engine; operational input like pricing.json)

purpose.kept: the target chain (name/provider/model/base_url/api-key ENV NAME) and the retry/cooldown policy
purpose.notKept: no credential VALUE is ever stored or logged (only `apiKeyEnv` names, §4.5 R4-3); the chain is deliberately NOT part of the frozen 12-key Profile (§4.2.4)
purpose.fallback: when the file is missing/unparsable the engine assembles the chain from the composed profile alone and REPORTS the problem in /api/status.fallback.problems (never silently 'no fallback')

name.description: stable target name: ledger `fallback_from`, SSE frame `from`/`to`, audit line

apiKeyEnv.description: ENV VAR NAME of this target's key; absent = the profile's api_key_env

visibility.sse: one `status` frame with phase:"fallback" (+ from/to/reason/attempt/effective_model); the event NAME set is unchanged (K5)
visibility.audit: <data dir>/fallbacks-audit.jsonl (authoritative, append-only, rotated at 16 MiB) + best-effort POST /api/audit when CELESTEA_AUDIT_URL is set
visibility.ledger: one row per ATTEMPT in usage-ledger.jsonl (`attempt` + `fallback_from`)
